validation_scope: Base native XPYTORCH: FP32/FP16/BF16/INT8, H2D/D2H, device copy bandwidth and bounded allocation capacity; fixed-image 2026-10-08 records and documented exceptions.
Base single-host communication: two/six-rank AllReduce and two-rank P2P; no all-topology or healthy eight-card qualification claim.
Toolkit native XRE/XBLAS: 12 cases on physical devices 4,7, five independent processes per point, 2026-10-09; 81 stable and 20 unstable repeat groups, run remains not-qualified.
basis: Maintainer-reviewed existing hardware records; explicit scoped release decision, following the Ascend validated + partial convention.
evidence_integrity: Hashes identify the retained review records; this public attestation does not embed raw evidence or certify every historical archive index.

exceptions: Three historical D2H pageable/nonblocking groups include windows shorter than 15 seconds; project acceptance does not override strict script rejection.
Seven-card group has only three repeats; eight-card measurement/stability passed but historical health was degraded.
Capacity is a bounded allocation observation with partial monitoring, not five-run throughput qualification.

limitations: No Training, Inference, Operation, FlagGems, multi-host, FP64, FP8 or TF32 validation.
Not a theoretical peak, all-card health, all-shape, all-topology or vendor dependency-consistency certification.
Toolkit pinned latency bimodality/CV > 5%, INT8 GemmEx-int32/Lt failures and whole-payload pinned async -999 remain recorded.
Registry pull is unverified; users must obtain the exact image with appropriate access.
New image, driver, shape, payload or topology requires validation of its own scope; a passing run cannot expand this declaration.
